content: पिण्ड {%a.%} (-ण्डी|{%f.%}) [पिण्ड्-अच्] .²1 Solid (घन). .²2 Compact, dense, close. .{@-ण्डः, -ण्डम्@} .²1 A round mass, ball, globe; as in अयःपिण्डः, नेत्रपिण्डः <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A lump, clod (of earth <ab>&c.</ab>). .²3 A round lump of food, morsel, mouthful; स न्यस्तशस्त्रो हरये स्वदेहमुपानयत् पिण्डमिवामिषस्य <ls>R. 2. 59</ls>. .²4 A ball or lump of rice offered to the Manes at obsequial ceremonies or Śrāddhas; नूनं मत्तः परं वंश्याः पिण्डविच्छेददर्शिनः . न प्रकामभुजः श्राद्धे स्वधासंग्रहतत्पराः <ls>R. 1. 66</ls>, <ls n="R.">8. 26</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 216</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 132</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 9.">136</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 9.">140</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 159</ls>. .²5 Food in general; सफलीकृतभर्तृपिण्डः <ls>M. 5</ls> ‘who was true to his masterʼs salt’. .²6 Livelihood, sustenance, subsistence; पिण्डार्थमायस्यतः <ls>Mu. 3. 14</ls>. .²7 Alms; पिण्डपातवेला <ls>Māl. 2</ls>. .²8 Flesh, meat. .²9 The foetus or embryo in an early stage of gestation. .²10 The body, corporeal frame; एकान्तविध्वंसिषु मद्विधानां पिण्डेष्वनास्था खलु भौतिकेषु <ls>R. 2. 57</ls>. .²11 A heap, collection, multitude. .²12 The calf of the leg; <ls>Māl. 5. 16</ls>. .²13 A round button. .²14 Anything round, thick, gross or solid. .²15 An object in general. .²16 A particular part of a house. .²17 (In <ab>astr.</ab>) A sine expressed in numbers. .²18 The twenty-fourth part of the quadrant of a circle. .²19 The frontal sinus of an elephant or its projection. .²20 A portico or shed in front of the door. .²21 Incense, frank-incense. .²22 (In <ab>arith.</ab>) Sum, total, amount. .²23 (In <ab>geom.</ab>) Thickness. .²24 The flower of a China rose. .{@-ण्डम्@} .²1 Power, strength, might. .²2 Iron. .²3 Fresh butter. .²4 An army. .²5 Water; <ls>L. D. B.</ls>

पिण्डिः, -ण्डी {%f.%} .²1 A round mass, ball. .²2 The nave of a wheel. .²3 The calf of the leg. .²4 The Aśoka tree. .²5 The long gourd (अलाबु). .²6 A house. .²7 A species of palm. .²8 A stool or seat. .²9 A pedestal for the image of a deity.
